# Adversarial sentinels for tests/test_runtime_launch_principals.py.
#
# This file exists ONLY so the scanner test can prove every forbidden launch-principal
# form is rejected. It lives under tests/fixtures/ with a .txt suffix so the scanner never
# discovers it as a production launch surface (tests/ is excluded and .txt is not a launch
# suffix). If any of these strings ever reappears in a real discovered launcher, the scanner
# fails. Each non-comment line below MUST be flagged by scanner.scan_text.
$Dsn = "host=localhost port=5432 dbname=applypilot_fleet user=postgres connect_timeout=5"
PGUSER=postgres
export PGUSER=fleet_worker
DSN="host=100.90.104.99 port=5432 dbname=applypilot_fleet user=fleet_worker connect_timeout=5"
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:example@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
CONN=postgres://fleet_worker:example@10.0.0.1:5432/applypilot_fleet
SET ROLE postgres;
SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION fleet_worker;
conn.execute(set_role("postgres"))
QUOTED="host=h dbname=applypilot_fleet user='postgres' password=x"
MIXED="host=h dbname=applypilot_fleet user = POSTGRES password=x"
QUERY=postgresql://h:5432/applypilot_fleet?user=fleet_worker&sslmode=require
ENCODED=postgresql://%70ostgres:example@10.0.0.1:5432/applypilot_fleet
$env:PGUSER = 'FLEET_WORKER'
dsn = os.environ.get("FLEET_PG_DSN") or os.environ.get("APPLYPILOT_FLEET_DSN")
p.add_argument("--dsn", help="Postgres DSN (default: DATABASE_URL / APPLYPILOT_FLEET_DSN env).")
RAWPSQL= & $psql --dbname=$Dsn -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "UPDATE fleet_config SET spend_cap_usd=0 WHERE id=1;"
PSENVSRC= if ($env:FLEET_PG_DSN) { $env:FLEET_PG_DSN } else { $env:APPLYPILOT_FLEET_DSN }
